about: Westport, Co. Mayo: tide times for Westport Quay, and the depth at the swimming steps at the Point. Template: swim, kind depth (the swim lab app, templates/tide-swim). The per-spot model configuration (tide-station offsets, seabed at the steps, step geometry, datum) is the app's data/point.json, its station's constants are data/tide_model.json and its sources are js/sources.js. Westport is the app's own first instance, so it overlays nothing; a new spot puts its own copies of those files in places/<slug>/app/.

tide.honestyTpl: Worked out from the Marine Institute's predictions for Roonagh Pier, at the mouth of Clew Bay, shifted to the Quay: high tide about {hw} minutes later, low tide about {lw} minutes later, from the Admiralty's 1868 Sailing Directions and its modern predictions for Inishgort. No tide gauge has measured the Quay itself.
